body.purpose: French interface copy and multilingual resource metadata.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cobalt action button used for the AI query and resource management.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--action-fill); color: #102a43; font: 750 14px/1.4 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--action-hover); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f1b83d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A wide white field for title, author, and topic search.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" type="search" aria-label="Titre, auteur, module ou mot-clé" placeholder="Titre, auteur, module ou mot-clé">
components.css: .ds-search { width: 100%; height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #cbd6dc; border-radius: 2px; background: #ffffff; color: #102a43; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f1b83d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: A compact navy navigation band with a mint bar mark.
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 68px; padding: 0 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; background: #102a43; color: #ffffff; font: 700 14px/1.4 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: #ffffff; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f1b83d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Module Label
components.description: An outlined Arabic course module label with RTL direction.
components.html: مدخل الى سوسيولوجيا الهجرة
components.css: .ds-module { display: inline-block; max-width: 100%; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #aebfd0; color: #24465f; font: 700 11px/1.45 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Resource Row
components.description: A ruled row identifying a course resource, its module, and its original source.
components.html:
Référence de cours

Auteur ou éditeur

مدخل الى سوسيولوجيا الهجرةOuvrir la source ↗
components.css: .ds-resource { padding: 22px 4px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(180px, 1.15fr) minmax(145px, .7fr) minmax(160px, auto); align-items: start; gap: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd6dc; color: #102a43; font: 400 13px/1.55 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-resource h3 { margin: 0 0 5px; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-resource p { margin: 0; color: #42586b; } .ds-resource a { color: #143e9d; font-weight: 750; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-resource a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f1b83d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Assistant Panel
components.description: A navy research area for questions grounded in saved course resources.
components.html: Posez une question au cours.
components.css: .ds-assistant { padding: 26px 32px 28px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr; align-items: center; gap: 18px 32px; background: #193c58; color: #ffffff; font: 400 13px/1.55 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-assistant h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.13; letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-assistant textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 76px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #7591a6; border-radius: 2px; background: #ffffff; color: #102a43; font: inherit; } .ds-assistant textarea:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f1b83d; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--action-fill); color: #102a43; font: 750 14px/1.4 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--action-hover); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f1b83d; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-assistant { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

narrative.overview:
The interface treats course references as public-interest information: legible labels, clear source ownership, a calm reading field, and practical wayfinding. French is the interface language; Arabic module names and multilingual resources retain their own language and direction rather than being visually flattened into French.

The visual system is restrained and flat. A deep navy masthead and assistant panel anchor a pale neutral canvas; cobalt identifies the active reading path. Ruled rows carry the content instead of a card grid. The interface prioritizes quick scanning and explicit source attribution over decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Civic navy with a single cobalt action accent.
Compact uppercase labels and a large, tightly tracked sans-serif display.
Flat surfaces, fine rules, and mostly square controls.
Resource entries preserve original language and right-to-left Arabic text.

rules.name: The Source-First Rule
rules.body: Color marks navigation and actions; it never replaces the resource title, publisher, or course module as the primary information.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the system sans for both display and body; establish hierarchy with scale, weight, and spacing, not decorative type contrast.

dos: Do preserve the Arabic module titles exactly and set their text direction to RTL.
Do identify the resource type, module, and original language before the description.
Do keep AI answers paired with links to retrieved resources.
Do use fine rules and tonal contrast to organize the library.
donts: Don't turn every reference into a card.
Don't translate or rewrite resource titles without an explicit editorial decision.
Don't use AI answers as legal advice or let them stand without source references.
Don't expose full indexed page text or model vectors in public API responses.
